targets.query: from(bucket: "twin_data") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_data") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "temperature")
from(bucket: "twin_data") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_data") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "vibration")

panels.title: Temperature - 10s Moving Average (AGGREGATION)
panels.description: aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: mean) applied to the raw temperature stream. Demonstrates aggregation/transformation of the time series.

targets.query: from(bucket: "twin_data") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_data") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "temperature") |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> yield(name: "mean")

panels.title: Vibration - 10s Max (AGGREGATION)
panels.description: aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: max) applied to the raw vibration stream. Demonstrates a second, different aggregation/transformation type.

targets.query: from(bucket: "twin_data") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_data") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "vibration") |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: max, createEmpty: false) |> yield(name: "max")

panels.title: Digital Twin Position (twin_state x/y/z)
panels.description: Raw digital twin state stream (position), shown separately from the sensor stream to clearly distinguish the two source types.

targets.query: from(bucket: "twin_data") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "twin_state") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "x" or r._field == "y" or r._field == "z")
